subject.title: fix(openshell): restore sandbox creation on current OpenShell

question: Should OpenClaw preserve matching legacy OpenShell runtime identities through upgrade, with users recreating a scope only when they want the new 19-character name?
rationale: This is an intentional upgrade-behavior choice affecting persisted runtime identities and remote workspaces; source-level tests establish the mechanism but cannot decide the desired support policy.

options.title: Preserve legacy runtimes during upgrade
options.body: Keep the proposed adoption behavior, require fresh and upgrade live proof on OpenShell v0.0.92, and document recreation as the opt-in path to the new name.

options.title: Require recreation on upgrade
options.body: Reject legacy identity adoption and make users recreate affected OpenShell scopes, accepting disruption to existing remote workspaces.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy runtimes during upgrade
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed adoption behavior, require fresh and upgrade live proof on OpenShell v0.0.92, and document recreation as the opt-in path to the new name.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the focused compatibility and upgrade-path implementation under review and is best placed to provide the missing live evidence for maintainer approval.
